extensionDescription.message: Select photos with the official Google Photos Picker and attach them to ChatGPT.

checkingGooglePhotosAccess.message: Google account authorized. Verifying Google Photos Picker access…

pickerReadyDetail.message: Google Photos Picker verified and ready

selectedGoogleAccount.message: Using the account selected in the official Google sign-in window.

currentChromeAccountUnknown.message: Using the current Chrome profile Google account.

authorizationRequired.message: Connect your Google account to use Google Photos.

authorizationFailed.message: Google Photos authorization failed. Please try connecting again.

authorizationExpired.message: Google Photos authorization expired. Please reconnect your Google account.

authorizationScopeMissing.message: Google Photos permission was not granted. Reconnect and allow the requested Google Photos access.

openChatGptFirst.message: Open ChatGPT in the active tab first.

developmentBuildNotConfigured.message: This development build is not configured for Google Photos. See the developer documentation.

privacySummary.message: Authorization is handled by Chrome and Google Identity. Selected photos are processed in browser memory. The extension has no custom backend, analytics, or telemetry.

googlePhotosServiceUnavailable.message: Google Photos is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.

googlePhotosPermissionDenied.message: Google Photos Picker access was rejected (403). Reconnect; if it persists, the extension OAuth/API configuration must be fixed by the maintainer.

googlePhotosRequestTimedOut.message: Google Photos did not respond in time. Check your connection and try again.

pickerOpeningFailed.message: Google Photos could not be opened. Please try again.

pickerOpeningInterrupted.message: The previous Picker start was interrupted. Click Google Photos to try again.

browserAuthorizationUnsupported.message: This browser does not support Chrome Google authorization for extensions. Use Google Chrome, or wait for an Edge-compatible OAuth build.

compatibilityWarnings.message: $1 compatibility warning(s) are available in the extension popup.
